Điều này khiến cổ phiếu công nghệ cao của Mỹ biến động.  
   
Đảng Dn chủ đã giành lại quyền kiểm soát cả hai viện Quốc hội trong cuộc bầu cử tuần trước. Các ứng viên đảng Dn chủ cũng chiến thắng trong các cuộc bầu cử thống đốc ở nhiều bang, trong đó có Texas, nơi có nhiều trung tm dữ liệu. items.title: How are we all feeling about AI right now? – Deseret News
items.summary: Fast-emerging artificial intelligence tools and software are stoking plenty of concerns as an increasing number of AI-driven misdeeds are reported. And alongside those incidents, predictions are coming from some within the AI development world that the technology could advance to the point of threatening the whole of humanity. [...] Johns Hopkins University professor and AI researcher Christopher Honey reviewed the new polling data and, in a Deseret News interview, said he sees a notable convergence between the Deseret News poll’s findings on artificial intelligence and what he discovered in his own national polling — people want safeguards around AI, but they also hope the technology will deliver meaningful advances. [...] Faster medical research and new treatments; earlier, more accurate diagnosis of disease; and scientific discovery beyond health occupied the top spots for both polling samples. Both audiences also matched up in their next three AI hopefulness rankings of improving accessibility for people with disabilities; lowering the cost of goods and services; and taking over dangerous or repetitive work.

items.title: Recent advances in AI are creating a 'paradigm shift' for robotics - Berkeley News
items.summary: Goldberg, who was recently inducted into the National Academy of Engineering, is presenting the new approach and results from months of testing this week at the Conference on Robot Learning. He and his team are also releasing open-source code for other roboticists to experiment with, built on NVIDIA’s Isaac open simulation framework  for developers, as well as an industry-standard benchmark for evaluating the performance of robots across industrial tasks. [...] Earlier this year, he and his team began experimenting with a change to the way the robot code is organized. Using a framework they called Graph-as-Policy, robot tasks are segmented into individual skills, such as finding an object, planning a grasp and moving the gripper without collisions. Goldberg likened it to individual building blocks that fit together into something much larger. [...] Berkeley-based Ambi Robotics, which specializes in logistics and warehouse order fulfillment, applied the new methods earlier this year to analyze parcel sorting data and test updates to robot behavior. Tests showed an increased capacity of over 15,000 packages sorted annually per robot; the change is now deployed across 30% of the company’s U.S. fleet.

items.title: Autonomous EV developer Humble Robotics adds $51M to expand - TT
items.summary:
Stay on top of transportation news: [Get TTNews in your inbox.]

Humble Robotics secured $51 million in new financing, bringing the autonomous electric vehicle developer’s total funding to $75 million less than a year after its founding. [...] Humble Robotics raised $51 million in Series A financing, bringing its total funding to $75 million less than a year after its founding.
 The company is developing the Humble Hauler, a battery-electric, cabless Class 8 autonomous vehicle for regional freight routes under 250 miles.
 Humble will fund customer pilots, testing, early manufacturing and expansion into vehicles for 40-foot containers and 53-foot dry van and refrigerated trailers. [...] Testing will rely heavily on simulation and AI rather than accumulating extensive highway mileage, Cohen told TT in May. Humble maps prospective freight routes, constructs simulated versions of them and repeatedly tests its autonomous-driving technology in those virtual environments.

items.title: Kenwood High School JROTC Robotics Program earns regional recognition - ClarksvilleNow.com
items.summary: During the current robotics’ competition season, Team 26163X captured first place at the Tennessee State Fair Robotics Competition. The team followed that performance with another first-place finish at a competition in Elizabethton, Tennessee, where it also received a technical award recognizing excellence in robot design and engineering. [...] The teams are scheduled to compete in the V5RC Arsenal Tech Fall Tournament in Fort Wayne, Indiana, and later at the Louisville Slugger Signature Competition, an event expected to attract top robotics programs from across the United States and several international teams. Cadets involved in the program say the experience extends beyond competition. “Robotics has taught us how to work together under pressure and find solutions when things don’t go as planned,” said a member of Team 26163X.”Every [...] CLARKSVILLE TN – The Kenwood High School JROTC Robotics Program has grown from a single robotics team into a four-team program that is competing successfully at regional and national-level events. The program currently fields Teams 26163X, 26163A, 26163L, and 26163S, providing students with opportunities to develop skills in engineering, programming, and problem-solving.

items.title: FDA seeks input on telesurgery, autonomous robotics
items.summary: The FDA is asking the robotics community to submit comments on the discussion paper by Jan. 5. Ahead of that deadline, a public workshop to discuss the topics raised in the paper is scheduled for Dec. 2-3. [...] Under an investigational device exemption from the FDA, Dr. Vipul Patel, founder and medical director of the Global Robotics Institute at AdventHealth Celebration in Florida, in October performed a robotic prostatectomy on a patient about 35 miles away. Last year, Patel completed a transatlantic prostatectomy, operating from Florida on a patient in Angola. [...] The Food and Drug Administration on Friday issued a discussion paper on robotic medical devices with autonomous or remote teleoperation capabilities and is requesting feedback on the systems’ benefits and risks.
